text:
Elena Park: FYI - EdgeMatrix Partner Day next Thurs. We're doing a 20-min joint session (marketplace listing + 2 short demos). Need final speaker order, demo rollback, kit pickup, and video recording plan.

Marcus Ng: I'll own demo routing & perf. Primary: EdgeMatrix appliance on booth LAN; fallback: Redwood Dedicated eu-west. Canary 60/40 for initial traffic. If p95 > 600ms OR any 5xx spike > 0.8% for 45s, fail to fallback.

Jules Rivera: I'll run speaker ops. Proposed order: opener (Elena) 5m, marketplace flow (EdgeMatrix) 7m, kernel perf tweak + inference demo (Marcus) 6m, short Qs 2m. Need slide deck + speaker bios by Tue noon.

Amit Desai: Swag & kits: 90 sticker packs, 40 polos, 30 USB sample drives. Kits (SKU RDW-EDGEMATRIX-KIT) shipped via RapidShip AWB RS998877, ETA Wed 18:00. Manifest: https://drive.example/rdw/edgematrix/manifest.pdf. Customs note: attach ECCN and vendor EIN.

Logi-bot: Reminder: venue requires signed waiver for demo hardware. Waiver uploaded; awaiting venue approval.

Marcus Ng: On the perf side, I'm going to enable continuous batching + small kernel tweak (set ENV RDW_CUDA_MMAP=1) on Edge appliance to reduce token latency. Will run perf sweep: `./bench --model llama-2-7b --seq 256 --bs 8`.

Elena Park: Media wants a recorded version for on-demand. Can we capture multicam (slides + demo screen) and a produced 10-min version? Also want consent language in sign-up form for recording.

Jules Rivera: AV checklist: HDMI adapters (USB-C, miniDP), 2x spare power strips, PoE switch, small mixer for mic, Ethernet patch, 1x local router for isolated demo VLAN. Onsite lead: Kai (local) +44-7700-1122. Kai can arrive 90m before show.

Amit Desai: RapidShip confirms customs docs received. Tracking: https://rapidship.example/track/RS998877. Local pickup contact: Anya +44-7700-3344.

Marcus Ng: Failover smoke test snippet (run from staging):

```
# simple ramp
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "X-RW-Route: edge" -d '{"prompt":"latency test"}' &
done
wait
```

Marcus Ng: If we hit errors, script auto-switch (pseudo):

```
if [ "$error_rate" -gt 0.8 ]; then
  curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/v1/route/switch -d '{"route":"dedicated-eu-west"}'
fi
```

Elena Park: Marketing wants a cross-post T+10m and a more detailed post on the Marketplace blog T+24h. They need short copy + 1 screenshot by Wed EOD. Legal signoff required for both.

Jules Rivera: For recording, media-bot: please create a recording calendar entry and arrange multicam capture. Also add a short post-event upload task to S3 and transcript generation.

media-bot: Recording scheduled - multicam + screen capture. Will upload raw footage to s3://redwood-events/edgematrix/ within 3h post-event and trigger auto-transcribe. Calendar invite sent.

Logi-bot: Rehearsal scheduled Wed 17:00 UTC. Invite already sent to speaker list.

Amit Desai: Local logistics: venue requires proof of insurance for shipped hardware. I uploaded policy PDF to the manifest folder. RapidShip will hand-deliver crate Wed evening to loading dock B.

Marcus Ng: Small note on model quantization: we'll run quantized 4-bit model for the demo (q4_k_m). Validate attention cache under 512 tokens; the bench script above covers it. Also will pin model version to avoid auto-rollout surprises.

Elena Park: Quick checklist: slides + bios (Tue noon), marketing copy + screenshot (Wed EOD), legal signoff (Wed noon), perf tests (Marcus Tue night), RapidShip confirmation (Amit Wed AM), rehearsal (Wed 17:00 UTC). Reply with :white_check_mark: when you complete your item.

Jules Rivera: :white_check_mark: Slides + bios uploaded to Drive.

Amit Desai: :white_check_mark: RapidShip confirmed and insurance uploaded.

Marcus Ng: :white_check_mark: perf sweep scheduled Tue 22:00 UTC. I'll post logs.

Logi-bot: Note: bring two printed emergency contact sheets and 1 spare HDMI splitter.
